copy.curiosityHook: Waking into a life stolen by time is shock enough, but what happens when a single touch reveals horrific fates you might be able to prevent?
copy.description: After a devastating car crash puts schoolteacher Johnny Smith in a five-year coma, he awakens to discover an unsettling new power: physical contact lets him see the past, present, and future of anyone he touches.
copy.vibeSummary: Somber, suspenseful sci-fi drama paced with deliberate tension and heavy emotional stakes, ideal for focused late-night viewing.
copy.whyWatch: David Cronenberg directs this thoughtful supernatural thriller, grounding high-concept psychic visions in profound personal loss and escalating suspense.
